reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model SE4570, which is a recalled model.
The date code on the label and the typed date code is 08/23, which is not one of the recalled date codes (07/22 NH or 08/22 NH). Under the date code rule, an out-of-range date code is a denial.
The purchase is from a listed retailer (www.grainger.com) dated 2023-04-19, inside the sale window, and no receipt is required. This does not change the outcome.
